description: Share one of this tenant's published tools with everyone (visibility: "public") or with a named group this tenant owns (visibility: "group", group: <name>). The tool keeps running in this tenant's own sandbox with this tenant's own secrets; a caller reaches it as <this tenant's namespace>.<name>.

expose_spec.description: Default false. When true, any tenant this tool is shared with may call host.tool_spec_shared to read its (redacted) spec.

group.description: Required when visibility is "group"; must already exist (host.group.create).

name.description: Local name of the tool to share.

tags.description: Catalog tags merged into the tool's existing ones (same rules as host.tool_publish).

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Optional on the connection that ran signup (or host.redeem): that connection is already bound to the tenant it created, so later calls on it need no tenant_key. On a connection with no Authorization: Bearer header and no prior signup, omitting it implicitly signs that connection up as a brand-new tenant and runs this call as it -- see host.whoami's source field. When both a header and this argument are present, the header wins.

visibility.description: "public" (needs a passing dry run of the current version), "unlisted", "group" or "url".

name: host.tool_share
